name: Kingswell
summary: Kingswell appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The load pays its way).

mentions.excerpt: Kingswell, on May 11, credited Berkshire Hathaway Energy with joining the buildout only where the largest cloud companies carry the full cost of building and running it.

sides.claim: BHE's stance of participating in data center buildouts only if hyperscalers bear the full construction and operating cost is a disciplined framework that lets it join a major infrastructure cycle without spreading risk and cost onto existing…
